question: Does the new rule contradict any existing rule, section or text?

What does a background pass read or overwrite mid-action?
When does a temporary marker or hold end, and what clears it?

Which kinds of record, message or item does the rule cover?
Which entry points, callers or creation paths must the change reach?
What happens to dependents when a record is removed, renamed or replaced?
Who performs, writes or owns each step, field or hand-off?
What state remains or is restored when a step fails partway?
What state survives a restart, and what is rebuilt or reset?
